title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode15 To Be So Lonely

rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's already 25:00?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Everyone was really on edge last night.
I hope we can have a little more fun today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey there! Everyone ready to get some work done?! Huh? Is it just you, Enanan? Where's K?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She's not here. She's been AFK all day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What? She hasn't overdone it already, has she?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I don't know. I sent a DM, but she never responded.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I hope everything's okay.
I knew her taking on everything like that would be too much. Without Yuki...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<.....
We don't need Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Come on, Enanan. You're not still angry, are you? If you keep frowning like that, you're going to end up with wrinkles.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I'm not angry.
I'm just saying that Yuki has no reason to be part of N25 anymore.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If she can make such great songs on her own, then why wouldn't she?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That may be true, but still...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Enanan's acting strangely too.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess I can't say I'm feeling all that great either, though. Everyone's worried about something.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm sure even K and Enanan are the same way.)

Be honest, K, Enanan, Amia...
You all want to disappear more than anyone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I bet Yuki's been struggling for a while now, too.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The day Yuki disappeared, I overheard her and her mom talking.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Her mom seemed like the kind of person who tends to push their own sense of values on others. Yuki brushed it off, saying that it doesn't really bother her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I figured it wouldn't be a problem if she was fine with things, but you saw the way she was acting in that place.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It made me think maybe Yuki was trying to please her mom by going along with whatever she thought was best.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's probably not just her mom, either.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Maybe Yuki has been changing herself to fit in with the expectations of everyone around her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Maybe she thought she had to always be a “good girl”, never inconveniencing others in order for them to like her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And now it's finally become too much to handle and she doesn't know what to do anymore. At least, that's the feeling I get.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm not saying I'm perfect or anything.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But I think I understand how she feels. I know how suffocating it can be always feeling pressured to fit into other people's expectations of you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I didn't realize you felt that way too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, well...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, wait a minute! What do you mean by that?! Even I have stuff to deal with, you know!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, sorry.
It's just that you always sound so carefree. Like you're always having fun.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, well you've gotta enjoy life while you can, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<It's no fun being negative all the time!
Don't you want to live every day to its fullest, Enanan?♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Well, sure. I want to enjoy myself.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I think Yuki just wasn't able to do that, though.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I bet she's been struggling alone for so long that she just reached her breaking point.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <If Yuki really did end up like this from being in so much pain, and now feels like she just wants to disappear...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I just think that sounds kinda sad.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'd like to try talking to her again.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We can go back by playing that “Untitled” song, right? If that's true...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<That's what Miku said.
But will talking to Yuki in her current state of mind achieve anything?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What was that?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh! It's a notification about OWN.
Yuki uploaded a new song!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Another one? She just released one not too long ago.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What? Two songs in a row? Wait, now it's three?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <How many is she making? What kind of songs are they?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What the hell?
They're even darker than before.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa! I'm getting shivers!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<This isn't good.
I can't put it into words, but I have a bad feeling about this...>
But if I can't find myself even then...then I'll just have to disappear.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Was she serious?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Enanan. Amia.>
